title: Add offline bundle pruner and distro-compatibility matrix
author: Anika Patel
description: Motivation: Air-gapped/offline bundles have grown large over time because OCI image indexes frequently carry historical layers, duplicated layers across images, and vendor toolchains that include optional components. Distribution and customer install times are suffering (long seed times, increased registry storage and transfer costs). This PR introduces a standalone 'bundle pruner' utility and a canonical lockfile schema (oci-lock-v2) plus a distro-compatibility matrix to make vendor bundles smaller, reproducible, and easier to validate before seeding.

release_notes: Introduce 'bundle-pruner' CLI: prunes unused OCI layers from offline bundles, outputs oci-lock-v2 canonical lockfile, and provides a prune-report with size savings; adds distro-compatibility matrix for selective shim inclusion; Terraform registry seed module bumped to support pruner-enabled seed jobs.
testing: Unit tests cover pruner logic (fingerprinting, dedupe, manifest signature checks). Integration e2e runs in an isolated k3s airgapped harness: validates that seeding with pruned bundles produces identical installed objects. Performance: typical reductions of 18-42% for our existing vendor bundles (measured on 3 sample catalogs).
rollback_instructions: If a pruned bundle causes installation issues, re-seed using the original oci-lock-v1 artifacts retained in the artifact store (we keep a 14-day backup by default). The installer exposes PRUNER_ENABLED toggle; set to false to skip pruning during seed jobs. A migration tool 'oci-lock-migrate --from v2 --to v1' is included to restore legacy layout if required.
notes_for_ops: Operational notes: run pruner in --dry-run first for large registries; use --concurrency to tune CPU/IO; the prune-report JSON includes lists of removed layer digests and total bytes reclaimed. The terraform bump changes the registry seed job image tag and adds an env var PRUNER_ENABLED=true by default; coordinate with on-prem customers when flipping the flag.
operational_impact: Reduced seed times and lower storage cost for private registries. Add new verification step to preflight which adds a small constant time overhead but prevents data-loss.
